comment: Taken for English Gen-Ed Credit. Grade based off two short papers and take-home midterm and final. Completing reading is not very necessary, everyone just comes to class and sits on their laptop while Dr. Eakin lectures. He's a really nice and intelligent professor, but his class is not very demanding. Show up and you'll at least get a B
Not an east A like many are saying, but an easy B. Class lectures can get boring but pay attention and write down everything he says. 2 short papers on assigned readings, 1 midterm 1 final.

Professor Eakin's FYS class was a breeze. He assigns lots of readings, but you do not really need to do any of it to do well. He is a nice guy and really wants people to participate, but does not strictly enforce it. We only had three papers to do, which were a bit lengthy, but considering it was the only work, it was definitely doable.

He assigns lots of reading but you don't have to do any of it. I had all the athletes in my class which shows how easy it is. We only had three papers all semester and I got A's on all of them. It's really hard to stay awake during class because he just talks the whole time, but I would highly recommend this FYS for an easy A.

Very easy Fys to take, impossible not to love the guy.  Graded on 3 papers, the first two are 3-5 pages and last one is 10.  Highly suggested if you want an easy A in an fys.  All athletes take it too, its a layup.

The class involves very little work, but it is extremely boring. Eakin is not as easy as everyone says. You are definitely guaranteed at least B in his class,tougher to get an A. Nice old fellow. Use the tests to pump your grade. Don't read, write down everything!! Excellent choice for history and literature geneds.

an extremely easy professor. Professor Eakin knows a lot about the subject and is very willing to answer questions and give additional help, though he speaks really slowly in class and it sometime can get a bit dull.  Still, if you want to learn, there is a lot that you can learn from the class.

Impossible not to like him. He repeats himself sometimes, but knows everything about Judaism and Christianity. Two or three papers, and as long as you support your claims with evidence you should be fine. Be careful though, citing the bible as a legitimate, factual, historical source will not help your grade(as some radical christians found out!)

If you want an A in Eakin's class just write down everything he says and then sort through it later during the week. I did that for the first half of the term. If you want a B go to class with your laptop and IM your friends, read emails, etc. and don't pay attention to what he says. I did that second half of the term. 2 tests, 2 papers, that's it.
No Comments

Professor Eakin knows his stuff.  If you want to learn a lot, you will.  If you want to get him off track, that's easy too.  I once got him off track for 3 weeks straight.  I learned a lot though.  And easy on stuff.

Professor Eakin talks very slowly.  It is easy to lose focus in his class because his tone does not change much.  If you want to do well in his class you must take notes on the main points that he says.  If you need help, he will help you to the best of his ability.  He grades very easily on his essays and he wants his students to succeed.

Dr. Eakin is a very nice man.  He talks unbelievably slowly.  For History of Judaism, he rarely talked about the subject, showed us tons of videos, and then expected great detail on the two tests he gave out all semester.  If you aren't familiar with Judaism, do not take his class - he does not give you hints whatsoever about what is on his exams.

Not a horrible class, but don't take it if your not going to be a religion major. The class is suppose to be the history of isreal, but the face is mose of israels ancient history is from the bible. If you like the bible and have read it itensivly, than take the class. His problem is he presumes everyone has a strong understanding of biblical text.

Dr. Eakin is an outstanding teacher who is always ready to lend a helping hand.  He understands the role of teacher and really makes you think about what to say in class and in papers.  Very helpful with getting one started on ideas of papers.
knows a lot

I'm in Intro. to Hebrew, a class that does not suit him very well.  He is a good teacher as a whole, but is not very good at teaching langauge classes.  He essentially reads from the book, assigning only one 20 page research paper for the entire class grade.  Easy class until the paper comes.
Great teacher, both clear and knowledgeable.  Really enjoyed the class and learned a lot.  Not hard to get an A
Excellent course -- and he really helps one to think about the context of Scripture.  Not challenging or affirming beliefs, but actual theology -- the STUDY of Scripture.  Loved it!
A great professor.  He's always willing to answer questions, and is a generous (and fair) grader on tests and essays. Interesting courses, great for your GPA.
He's awesome.  Very kind, brillant, and reasonable.  What more could you ask for.

Eakin's incredible. He really helped me out this past year. I thought i was a pretty decent OT scholar but i learned so much from him, even though i've previously had several classes with a rabbi. You won't regret taking him. In fact, your gpa will thank

Dr. Eakin is one of those profs who makes you want to learn. He is always helpful in and out of class on any topic. He really knows his stuff, but never makes you feel unimportant or silly for asking a question. He always treats students with respect.

So awesome.  Easy, only 2-2 pg papers for whole class. definitely take history of judaism. eakin is so smart, caring enough to make u want him as a grandpa, and incredibly easy with his grading policies.
